subject: science
concept: Understanding weathering and erosion as slow processes that reshape the land over time
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Surface Processes) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student runs a simple water-flow-over-sand simulation to observe erosion happening
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences pictures showing a landform slowly changing over a long time due to erosion
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between weathering (breaking down) and erosion (moving material)

misconception_flags: believes erosion happens quickly/suddenly rather than as a slow ongoing process

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
